mod.help: Settings for the Infinite Ailment mod.

duration.label: Duration (s)
duration.help: How long the damage lasts, in seconds. -1 = infinite. Vanilla: {vanilla}.

percent.label: Damage (%)
percent.help: Percent of your max HP lost each tick; negative heals. Vanilla: {vanilla}.

fixed.label: Damage
fixed.help: Flat damage each tick, added on top; negative heals. Vanilla: {vanilla}.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
